incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In the 5-minute window ending 12:48:26, checkout had ~10 ERROR spans (increase of traces_span_metrics_calls_total status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR) against ~97.5 non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) checkout spans. The ERROR spans split into oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (~5) and checkout's own client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (~5); no other checkout operation carried an ERROR status in that window.

Payment itself produced ~5 ERROR spans on its own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and ~16.25 STATUS_CODE_UNSET payment spans in the same 5-minute window, i.e. payment is the only dependency service besides checkout with an observed ERROR series (cart's only ERROR series was exactly 0).

The payment server span is ERROR with error tags grpc.error_name=Error, grpc.error_message and exception.message "Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold", and the exception stacktrace originates at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) reached via Object.chargeServiceHandler (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22).

On checkout, the failing child span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=2 and status description "Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold", and its parent oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and status description "failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold".

Failed checkout trace ids observed: e4811ba2be27c827b20f4de320ce6117, 5416da0a0541e9db14f5f92d2a9496ad, 9c7861c98a02708e00a73334dae0bb4f and 234cd55dbe0898567c0761993de6a392; successful (rpc.grpc.status_code=0) PlaceOrder traces in the same sample include 078b07d731483b3b648f67c8b2354fdc, 26ed32bda082db5bd7f3c67193c40020 and b3bac7388e67ab4c98263c8d41149315.

In the same failed traces, frontend span POST /api/checkout (http.status_code 500, error=true), frontend-proxy spans ingress and "router frontend egress" (http.status_code "500", error=true) and load-generator span POST (http.status_code 500, error=true) are ERROR, with the frontend's executing-api-route span carrying the propagated message "13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token.".

Checkout's client-observed average latency (rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_sum/count, checkout service) shows no elevation versus the comparable 1-hour-earlier window: PaymentService/Charge status 0 7.91 ms vs 6.78 ms, Charge status 2 11.08 ms vs no measurable baseline, CurrencyService/Convert 2.18 vs 2.06 ms, CartService/GetCart 1.51 vs 1.25 ms, CartService/EmptyCart 6.58 vs 5.98 ms, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 0.656 vs 0.544 ms, ShippingService/GetQuote 5.36 vs 6.67 ms, ShippingService/ShipOrder 0.399 vs 0.589 ms.

Server-side rpc_server_duration_milliseconds averages also show no elevation: checkout PlaceOrder 44.2 ms in the last 5 minutes vs 51.2 ms one hour earlier, and product-catalog GetProduct 0.170 ms vs 0.231 ms.
The failing checkout PlaceOrder spans are not slow: in the sampled traces they lasted 19.9–27.1 ms, while successful PlaceOrder spans in the same sample lasted 30.0–92.4 ms.

The error burst is recent and intermittent: the 5-minute increase of ERROR spans for checkout and payment was 0 at every step from 10:53:26 through 12:13:26, first became nonzero at the 12:18:26 step (checkout ~17.5, payment ~8.75), was 0 again at 12:23:26, then ~17.5/~8.75 at 12:28:26, ~2.5/~1.25 at 12:33:26 and 12:38:26, ~5/~2.5 at 12:43:26 and ~10/~5 at 12:48:26.

Cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email show no error evidence for this window: cart's only ERROR series (POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart) was exactly 0 and no ERROR series existed for product-catalog, currency, shipping or email; these services were serving spans (cart ~215 UNSET, product-catalog ~170 UNSET, currency ~23.75 STATUS_CODE_OK, shipping ~25 UNSET, email ~20 UNSET) and checkout's client calls to them report rpc_grpc_status_code=0. They are therefore checked with no observed failure, though a missing ERROR series is unknown rather than proven zero.

Elevated dependency latency as the cause of checkout's errors is rejected: checkout client-side averages for every dependency call (payment, currency, cart, product-catalog, shipping) are within roughly 2 ms of the 1-hour-earlier baseline, checkout's PlaceOrder server average is lower than baseline (44.2 vs 51.2 ms), and the failing PlaceOrder spans are shorter than successful ones.

Payment's failure is thrown during token/charge validation inside its own charge handler and may be flag-gated: the failing payment span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries a child span grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (5053 us, rpc.grpc.status_code=0, i.e. flagd responded successfully) and a child span charge, before throwing at charge.js:37. Feature-flag configuration cannot be inspected here, so flag-gating of the failure is unconfirmed.

The rejection may be scoped to a specific card token or loyalty tier rather than to all traffic: all four sampled failing PlaceOrder spans carry the message text including "app.loyalty.level=gold", while successful PlaceOrder spans in the same sample completed with rpc.grpc.status_code=0. The sample does not show which token or tier the successful calls used, so this remains unconfirmed.

The onset of the error burst between the 12:13:26 and 12:18:26 metric steps (zero errors in the preceding ~85 minutes) is consistent with a change in payment's failure configuration or in the card tokens presented by the load generator at about that time; no change history is integrated, so a triggering change is not observed.

gaps: No ERROR series exist for product-catalog, currency, shipping or email in this window, and a missing series is unknown rather than zero, so absence of errors in those services is not proven (only cart has an explicit 0).

Kubernetes state, pod logs and change history are not integrated, so no deployment, restart or configuration change can be tied to the ~12:13–12:18 onset, and payment's flagd flag values / card-token source cannot be inspected.

ERROR and UNSET span counts come from increase() extrapolation over a 5-minute window and include internal, client and server spans; they are span counts, not request counts, so an exact request-level error rate for PlaceOrder is not established.

The trace view was sampled: 20 checkout traces (408 spans) and 6 payment traces (228 spans), of which 100 span rows were read; spans outside those slices and all uninstrumented traffic remain unknown, and trace span counts are not unique request counts.

A checkout client series rpc_client_duration_milliseconds for oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart with rpc_grpc_status_code="9" returned NaN, so whether any gRPC status 9 EmptyCart call actually occurred cannot be determined from it.
next_steps: Have a human inspect payment's feature-flag configuration (flagd) and the card tokens used by the load generator to confirm whether the "Invalid token" rejections are flag-gated or data-driven.
Review payment service logs and recent deployment/configuration changes around 12:13–12:18 UTC, which requires log and change-history access not available in this Run.
Track checkout PlaceOrder error ratio and payment Charge error ratio per 5-minute step to confirm whether the intermittent burst persists or grows.
report_parsed.summary: Checkout's elevated errors are real and trace to payment: in the last 5 minutes checkout produced ~10 ERROR spans (~5 on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and ~5 on its client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge), and payment produced ~5 ERROR spans on its own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge. The exact error is thrown inside payment at charge.js:37 — "Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold" (gRPC status 2 on the client, surfaced by checkout as PlaceOrder grpc status 13 with the message "failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token."). Latency was not elevated anywhere: checkout's client-observed average durations for all dependency calls (Charge, Convert, GetCart, GetProduct, GetQuote, ShipOrder, EmptyCart) are within ~2 ms of a comparable 1-hour-earlier baseline, checkout's PlaceOrder server average is 44.2 ms now vs 51.2 ms baseline, and the failing PlaceOrder spans are faster (19.9–27.1 ms) than successful ones (30.0–92.4 ms). The error burst is recent and intermittent: checkout/payment error increases were 0 at every 5-minute step from 10:53:26 to 12:13:26, first nonzero at 12:18:26, with further nonzero steps at 12:28:26, 12:33:26, 12:38:26, 12:43:26 and 12:48:26. Cart, currency, shipping, email and product-catalog show no error evidence and normal latency; frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator carry HTTP 500 error spans in the same failed traces. The deepest supported cause is payment's own charge-path rejection of the card token; whether that rejection is flag-gated (a flagd evaluation span is a child of the failing payment span) or caused by the token supplied by the caller is not established.
